blocks.text: 5-Day Corporate Tour in Rio de Janeiro

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: The Word title is Congress in Rio de Janeiro and gives five days separately; it has no equivalent standalone corporate-tour title. The RU title is translated with the confirmed duration.

blocks.text: This five-day programme combines a congress in Rio de Janeiro with visits to the city's main sights and group dinners. Mornings on several days are devoted to business sessions. Afterwards, the group visits Corcovado and Sugar Loaf, explores the city and chooses one of the optional programmes for Day 4.

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: Word paragraph 15 gives a shorter overview; the combined RU lead, including five days, business mornings and the specific Day 4 choice, has no corresponding single passage. The RU summary is translated using the verified Word place names.
The Word provides individual service rates and an on-request Day 4 activity, but no total programme price. The current RU total-price status is retained as text without assigning any amount.
